name: Trip Concierge
summary: Paste or forward your booking emails and it builds the trip plan, then tells you what to do and when, from check-in to the hotel door.
handles: Reads flight, hotel and car rental confirmations into one trip
Check-in reminder 24 hours before each flight, with the airline's check-in page
Destination weather and a packing list 2 days before you go
Tells you when to leave for the airport
Hotel address on check-in day, one tap to Maps
Same again for the flight home
talk: add hotel Marriott Times Square dec 3-6
setup: Paste a confirmation email into its chat, or forward it to its inbox address (shown under Settings).
Optional: an iPhone Shortcut on the Share sheet with "Get contents of URL" (POST, the text as the body) to its inbox address sends any booking email in one tap.

fields.label: Hours at the airport
fields.help: How early to be at the airport before departure. Leave empty for 2 hours domestic, 3 international. Example: 2.5

after: Paste your next flight or hotel confirmation into the chat, or type "add flight UA123 dec 3 08:15 SFO-JFK". Then say "trips".
